title: Thai-Style Pumpkin Soup
description: A creamy slow-cooker pumpkin soup flavoured with Thai red curry paste, coconut milk, lime and fish sauce.
ingredients: 1.5kg (3lb 5oz) pumpkin or butternut squash, peeled, deseeded and cut into large chunks
400ml (14fl oz) can of light coconut milk
TO SERVE: coriander leaves, sliced red chillies, pepper
steps: Put the pumpkin or squash, carrot, onion and coconut milk into the slow-cooker pot.
Make up the hot stock in a jug and stir in the red curry paste to dissolve. Pour it into the slow-cooker pot.
Add the salt, stir, place the lid on the slow-cooker and cook on high for 4 hours, or on low for 6 hours.

Once cooked and the pumpkin or squash is tender, use a hand blender to whizz it into a creamy soup, then stir in the honey, fish sauce and lime juice and season with pepper. Serve with coriander leaves and sliced red chillies.
notes: Oven method: 200°C/180°C fan, Gas Mark 6 — mix ingredients in a large casserole dish with lid, cook for 45 minutes, then blend. Different Thai curry pastes have different heat levels — check the instructions.
